method: All downloads saved unmodified in raw/up_market_oct with url, UTC time, bytes and sha256 (MANIFEST.txt; failed fetches kept as evidence). PDFs converted with pdftotext -layout; all parsing in pull/up_market_oct/build.py run with python3 -I.

HBR September 2026: parsed pages 2 (month and YTD indicator tables), 5 (monthly closed sales), 11 (pending), 12 (active), 14 (months supply history), 26-27 (active by price range), 31-32 (months supply by price range). Months supply recomputed from pages 5 and 12 and matched to print.

RAM September 2026: parsed Single Family, Condominium and All Properties overview tables and the monthly Pending, Closed, Inventory and Months Supply tables; months supply recomputed (inventory / 12-month average pending) for SF and condo and matched to print.

Title Guaranty RSR: page 1 parsed for counts, medians, dollar volume, % changes (PDF arrow glyphs m/p = up, q = down; verified against rendered page images and against 309/278 = +11.2%), sidebar averages (rounded in source) and DOM. The DOM label differs by island on the rendered page: Oahu "MEDIAN DOM", Maui/Hawaii/Kauai "AVERAGE DOM" (text layer carries both labels; read from rendered images).

Report method reproduced: Realtor.com county active_listing_count / mean(DBEDT MEI SF + condo resales for the month and prior two months). Aug 2026 reproduces 5.2 / 9.6 / 8.4 / 6.5 exactly, and Jul 2026 matches page_data ext.mos.

Provisional September 2026 value by the report method uses Realtor.com Sep active listings and substitutes board (HBR, RAM) or Title Guaranty (Kauai, Hawaii Island) September sales for the not-yet-published DBEDT September rows.

Definition sensitivity matrix (derived): for Oahu and Maui, board active inventory divided by (a) 3-month average closed, (b) 12-month average closed (HBR definition) and (c) 12-month average pending (RAM definition), from the boards' own monthly tables.
notes: HBR September 2026 numbers come from the HBR-authored PDF hosted at oahure.com (a brokerage site). HBR's own channels had not posted the September release at retrieval (hicentral /mpr/mpr-2026-09.php 404; Prezly RSS newest = August, 2026-09-06). HBR normally releases on the 6th. Treat as official HBR data from a mirror; re-confirm against hicentral when posted.

Months-of-supply definitions differ: HBR = active (A status) inventory / rolling 12-month average CLOSED sales; RAM (ShowingTime) = inventory at month end / 12-month average PENDING sales; the report = Realtor.com active listings (all listing types combined, county level) / 3-month average DBEDT closed SF+condo resales. Same-month figures are not interchangeable.

HBR days on market = median days from first listed to offer ACCEPTED. RAM "Days on Market Until Sale" = AVERAGE days from listing to CLOSE. Title Guaranty prints "MEDIAN DOM" for Oahu and "AVERAGE DOM" for the other islands, undefined. Do not compare DOM across these sources.
HBR "% of original list price received" is a median vs ORIGINAL list price; RAM "Percent of List Price Received" is an average vs MOST RECENT list price.

RAM All Properties Combined exceeds SF + condo (Sep 2026: inventory 1,511 vs 457 + 822 = 1,279; pending 120 vs 109; closed 132 vs 124). The report does not say which other property types are included.
RAM revises prior months: the Sep report shows Aug 2026 SF inventory 477 / MSI 8.2 and condo 844 / 12.3, against 473 / 8.1 and 839 / 12.2 as first published on 2026-09-01.

The report text pairs the Aug 2026 report-method figure for Maui (9.6) with RAM's September board figures (11.0; houses 7.8, condos 12.1). RAM's August figures as first published were 11.1 (8.1 / 12.2); September is 11.0 (7.8 / 12.1). Either is fine if the month is labelled.

Title Guaranty RSRs do not state their data source. Maui RSR September month figures equal RAM exactly (count, median, dollar volume, SF average DOM); Maui condo average DOM (210 vs RAM 199) and YTD condo (619 / $657,500 vs RAM 620 / $655,000) differ slightly. Oahu RSR condo Sep 2025 count was 879 against HBR 408, which suggests TG includes closings outside HBR resales (e.g. new-project deliveries); this is an inference, not stated by TG. Kauai RSR Aug equalled the board/DBEDT figures. Oahu RSR differs from HBR (Sep SF 309 vs 293; condo 391 vs 375; Aug SF 274 in the Aug RSR, 278 in the Sep RSR chart, vs HBR 264), so it is a broader or differently timed universe. Hawaii Island RSR differs slightly from DBEDT (Aug SF 150 vs 153).
Title Guaranty sidebar values (average list/sold, max sold) are printed rounded (e.g. "$1.4 M"); usd_approx is the printed value expanded, not an exact figure.
Realtor.com flags Maui County (15009) with quality_flag = 1 in Jul, Aug and Sep 2026 (and per the earlier audit every month since Dec 2025). Treat the report-method Maui value as lower-confidence.

Cells with fewer than 20 units are flagged (flag_lt20): Kauai TG Sep SF 18 and condo 6; TG Statewide Aug Kauai SF/condo; HBR price brackets with fewer than 20 active listings or fewer than 20 implied average monthly closings (SF brackets below $800K and $3M+; condo below $150K and $1.5M+).
Aggregates only. No owner names, street addresses or TMKs. Title Guaranty neighborhood and "top condominium" tables were not extracted.
gaps: Kauai Board of REALTORS (https://www.kauaiboard.com/): HTTP 403 Forbidden on 2026-10-09 (earlier: SiteGround captcha). Not bypassed. No board months of inventory, active listings or pending for Kauai.

Hawaii Island REALTORS (https://www.hawaiiislandrealtors.org/) and Hawaii Information Service (https://www.hawaiiinformation.com/): HTTP 403 Forbidden on 2026-10-09. Not bypassed. No board months of inventory for Hawaii Island.

Latest board-sourced neighbor-island data reachable: Title Guaranty Statewide Housing Statistics August 2026 (board counts and medians, month and YTD) and Fidelity National Title August 2026 YTD summaries (KBOR / HIS). Neither has inventory or months of supply. DBEDT MEI shows (NA) for Kauai and Hawaii County inventory.
No September 2026 board figures for Kauai or Hawaii Island were found. Title Guaranty RSR September 2026 counts/medians are the only September source (title company, reported).
Title Guaranty Statewide Housing Statistics September 2026 (9.2026) not posted (URL redirected to home page); Fidelity has no September 2026 editions yet.
HBR September 2026 Local Market Update (district/TMK tables) not found (oahure.com 09-2026-Sep-B-LMU.pdf and 08-2026-Aug-B-LMU.pdf return 404).
RAM All Properties monthly pending series is not printed, so the 11.0 all-properties months supply cannot be recomputed from the report.

Standard price tiers: HBR brackets do not split at $750K (inside $700-799K for SF; inside $700-999K for condos) or $10M ($3M+ top SF bracket; $2M+ top condo bracket), so tier-level months of supply cannot be computed; SF active listings by tier given with bounds.
DBEDT MEI September 2026 (due ~2026-10-29) not yet released, so the report-method September value is provisional.

definition_sensitivity_sep_2026_derived.note: Derived from board monthly tables; only the HBR-definition (Oahu) and RAM-definition (Maui) cells are published by the boards. HBR pending = contracts entered in the month still in escrow at month end; RAM pending = offers accepted in the month, so the pending-based Oahu cells are approximate analogues.

reading: Oahu: the report method (5.2 Aug; ~5.2 Sep provisional) sits between HBR houses (3.2) and condos (7.0); by HBR's own definition the SF+condo combination would be 5.40 (derived). Using HBR inventory with the report's 3-month denominator gives 4.93: Realtor.com counts about 176 more Oahu listings than HBR active SF+condo.

Maui: the report method gives 9.6 (Aug) / ~10.4 (Sep provisional) against RAM 11.0 all properties (houses 7.8, condos 12.1). Restricting RAM's own definition to SF + condo gives 10.06 (derived), so about one month of the gap is property-type scope (RAM all-properties inventory 1,511 vs SF+condo 1,279) and the rest is the denominator and Realtor.com's listing count (1,367, quality-flagged).

Kauai and Hawaii Island: no board months of supply reachable; only the report method exists (Aug 8.4 and 6.5; Sep provisional ~9.6 and ~7.1 using Title Guaranty September counts, Kauai on very small samples).

Whatever the denominator (3-month closed, 12-month closed, 12-month pending), Oahu houses come out at 2.8-3.2 months (seller territory) and Maui condos at 11.0-12.2 months (buyer territory); Oahu condos 6.5-7.0, Maui houses 7.7-7.9.
